skeptic.label: Critical
skeptic.description: AI is overhyped, and the hype is itself a power play; the harm lies in ownership, extraction, and labor. Remedies are structural: antitrust, interoperability, bargaining power.

skeptic.label: Institutional
skeptic.description: AI is a general-purpose technology whose impact diffuses slowly, like electricity or the internet; existing institutions, adapted sector by sector, can govern it. Resilience over prevention.
